name: SplitMetrics Lyra
original_description:
Make video and image ads for your mobile app with SplitMetrics Lyra in ChatGPT: UGC videos, short drama story ads, static banners and carousels, ready to test on TikTok, Meta, Google and other ad networks. Start from a brief, an idea or a simple prompt, and get finished ads built from your brand kit and app assets.

For example, you can:
• Make video ads in any style: branded, engaging story-driven, UGC, short drama, or app UI motion with your real screens.
• Remake a competitor’s ad for your app.
• Turn a winning ad into new angles, hooks and audience versions.
• Resize and translate creatives for every placement and language.

Every ad is an editable workflow in your SplitMetrics Lyra workspace. Generation spends your workspace credits, and you confirm before every run. Connect your SplitMetrics Lyra account to get started.
